verdict.rationale: Morph documents very high throughput for its specialized models: Fast Apply / morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and ~90ms classifier latency. Automatic prefix caching and reserved dedicated endpoints also support latency-sensitive serving. These figures cover the specialized tools, not general chat generation, and nothing quantifies time-to-first-token. Missing for 10: TTFT figures or latency SLAs, throughput numbers for the general open-weight chat models (e.g. Kimi K3), and independent or hands-on speed benchmarks.
